facts.text: The Centre has eased GST rules on post-sales discounts starting November 1 without requiring a prior agreement, directly supporting retail discount flexibility on everyday household goods across FMCG and pharma sectors.

facts.text: The government issued the official notification on October 26 to implement revised GST discount rules and expedite provisional refunds.

scenes.label: HOOK

visual.prompt: Close, frame-filling view of a crowded Indian kirana shop shelf packed with soap bars, shampoo bottles and medicine strips, bright colourful discount stickers with no readable text, warm evening light, a sense of anticipation

scenes.vo: 1 November se GST badla, kya dukaan par cheezein sasti hongi?

scenes.label: SETUP

visual.prompt: A delivery truck unloading cartons of soap and medicine boxes outside a row of small Indian shops, a distributor's helper carrying boxes, busy morning street

scenes.vo: Socho, sabun aur dawai ki company maal dukaanon tak bhejti hai.

scenes.label: SETUP

visual.prompt: SHOPKEEPER at his kirana counter smiling as a company sales representative in a formal shirt hands him a sealed envelope, stacks of empty cartons behind, late afternoon

scenes.vo: Mahine ke end mein company kehti hai, zyada becha, toh discount lo. Isse post-sale discount kehte hain, yaani bikne ke baad mila discount.

scenes.label: THE RULE

visual.prompt: An office desk in a small company with a thick paper contract file, a rubber stamp and a frowning accountant flipping pages, tube light, cluttered files

scenes.vo: Pehle GST mein shart thi, yeh discount pehle se agreement mein likha ho. Agreement nahi, toh credit note se tax kam nahi hota tha.

scenes.label: THE TERM

visual.prompt: Close view of a printed bill on a table with a smaller slip of paper clipped to it, a pen beside, an accountant's hand pointing at the slip, simple clear composition, no readable text

scenes.vo: Credit note yaani bill ko baad mein chhota karne wali parchi.

scenes.label: THE CHOICE

visual.prompt: A company manager at a meeting table pushing a pile of discount envelopes back into a drawer, colleagues nodding nervously, evening office mood

scenes.vo: Toh companies ne socha, notice ka jhanjhat kyon lein? Discount hi kam do, ya der se do.

scenes.label: THE WHY

visual.prompt: A worried accountant imagining a stern tax officer holding a thick notice file, shown as a thought cloud above his head, dim office light

scenes.vo: Logic seedha tha, tax officer se jhagda, chhote discount se mehnga padta.

scenes.label: THE COST

visual.prompt: A balance scale on a shop counter, one side heavy with coins labelled only by colour, the other side light with a small discount envelope, SHOPKEEPER looking at it with a sigh

scenes.vo: Nateeja, tax poore daam par lagta raha, discount ke baad bhi. Kai cheezon par 18 percent GST hai, toh yeh farak chhota nahi.

scenes.label: WHAT CHANGED

visual.prompt: The same accountant now relaxed, closing the thick contract file and attaching a small slip to a bill, sunlight coming through the office window, calm mood

scenes.vo: Ab 1 November se pehle wale agreement ki zaroorat khatam. Company baad mein bhi discount de, credit note se tax ka hisaab saaf.

scenes.label: THE TWIST

visual.prompt: SHOPKEEPER holding a discount envelope behind his counter, thinking, while WIFE stands on the other side with a shopping bag waiting, evening shop light

scenes.vo: Lekin twist yeh hai, yeh discount seedha aapki jeb mein nahi aata. Pehle dukaandaar tak pahunchta hai, aage dena uski marzi.

scenes.label: WHAT YOU CAN DO

visual.prompt: WIFE at the kirana counter comparing a product pack with her bill, pointing politely, SHOPKEEPER smiling and explaining, SG standing beside her nodding, warm evening

scenes.vo: Agli baar bill par MRP aur asli daam milao, scheme poochho. Yeh investment advice nahi hai.

scenes.label: SEND

visual.prompt: A small Indian street of kirana shops at dusk, shop lights glowing, a shopkeeper receiving a carton from a delivery man, friendly closing mood

scenes.vo: Yeh us dukaandaar dost ko bhejo, jise company se scheme milti hai.
